purpose: Original technical import fixture; not game content or balance
origin: Project-authored parametric cubes and keyframes using tools/create_probe.py; no third-party art inputs
storage: Small source and prepared asset are versioned directly in Git; no LFS dependency for P0
units: metres; Blender Z-up exported as glTF/Godot Y-up; unit scale and applied object scales are 1
geometry: Two cubes, each 12 triangles, flat unit normals and one material; no skeleton, collision or external textures
animation: Pulse, 0–60 frames at 30 fps, 2 seconds; Bob centre Y=1.2, 1.5, 1.2, 0.9, 1.2 at quarter cycles
rights: Original project material. Repository-wide licensing remains undecided; no new license is assigned here.
